verdict.rationale: Bench provides downloadable reports (income statements, balance sheets, 1099 reports) that customers can export, but there's no evidence of a comprehensive open-format data export covering all financial data, transactions, or full account history for a clean exit — no documented data portability/export-all feature, no API access (probes show 404s for llms.txt, openapi endpoints). missing for 10: full data export/portability documentation, open format specifications (CSV/JSON/OFX), API access for bulk data retrieval, evidence of ability to fully migrate away with all historical data.
